meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 你提出发布并给出更新级别(补丁/新功能/大版本)后,Claude 会触发 GitHub 自动发布流水线并跟进到跑完,核对 npm 与 GitHub 上的发布结果,补写发布说明、发 Discord 公告;失败时只报告,不顺手改代码。
howto.when: 当你说出 publish、release、deploy 等词时触发;它必须拿到补丁/新功能/大版本或具体版本号才会跑完整流程,否则会先问。

say.text: 帮我 publish 一个 patch 修复版本。
say.note: 以补丁级别触发发布,并跟进验证流程。

say.text: 帮我执行一次 minor release。
say.note: 按新功能级别触发发布,并核验 npm 结果。

say.text: 帮我用 5.0.0-beta.9 执行 npm publish。
say.note: 按给定预发布版本号启动 npm 发布流程。

howto.what_en: When you request a publish with a release type, Claude runs the GitHub Actions release workflow to completion, verifies the npm/GitHub release artifacts, drafts release notes, attempts a Discord announcement, or reports a failure and stops.
howto.when_en: Activates when you say publish, release, deploy, or an equivalent release request; it runs the workflow only after you give patch/minor/major or an explicit version, otherwise it asks first.

say_en.text: Publish a patch fix release to npm.
say_en.note: Triggers a patch-level release and tracks it.

say_en.text: Run a minor release for the latest changes.
say_en.note: Runs a minor release and verifies the result.
Starts the release at the given prerelease version.
